::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 18 [1898]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

My dear [Miss Merriman](people/person_991.qmd)[^1] 
I am sorry to hear [Mrs Sumner](people/person_1381.qmd)is laid up but I am sure it is a good thing that she should be obliged to take a little entire rest. The MSS went last week. I thought they would be easier to look over as proofs, and I wanted to have [Christabel Coleridge](people/person_329.qmd) while she is here. [Mrs Matthew](people/person_1689.qmd) has asked me the last moment available for the report of the meeting, I begged her to avoid too many names to take up room. I go into Devon from the 7th to the 17th of June. I hope the proofs will come in good time.

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The name is illegible, but seems to begin with an M and end with man.  CMY's correspondent was evidently working for the [Mothers' Union](organizations/other_31.qmd).
